turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Good morning, Orion Shield Insurance, Marcus speaking. How may I help you?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi, I'd like to cancel my car policy. I found something cheaper and, frankly, I'm annoyed about the price rise. I'm worried I'll lose a lot of money.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Right. Before I ask for a few details, I need to let you know that this call is recorded for quality and training purposes. Can I take your full name and date of birth, please?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Samuel Adeyemi, 20 December 1988.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. And can you confirm your policy number or postcode?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It's TK2 2ZF.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Can I confirm which policy this is, car or home?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: The car insurance.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, I've recorded all of that on your file.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you promise me this won't cost me anything extra?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can't promise how it will be priced, the system will calculate it and you'll get it in writing.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can't you just waive the fee? It seems unfair.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I completely understand why that's frustrating, but I'm not able to make an exception, it's a fixed term of the policy. I'm happy to explain how it works if that helps.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just so you know, the change is subject to an underwriting review and a pro-rata premium adjustment, with any mid-term amendment fee applied.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sorry, I don't follow, what does any of that mean?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It's all in the policy wording, I'm afraid. Anyway, let's move on.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me explain what happens here. Since you took the policy out within the last 14 days, you're in the cooling-off period, so you'd get a full refund as long as no claim has been made.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Right, I see.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, Samuel. I've logged your cancellation request under reference REQ-26172, and our policy services team will process it and confirm in writing.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just to recap, i've logged your cancellation request.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No, that's everything, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance, Samuel. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
